actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA and CNV identity evidence (metabolic/coagulation profile with 6p loss and 20q gain), no plausible technical confounder for the RNA/CNV signal, and low label echo. Cross-modal support is weak and boundaries are not sharp, so structural defensibility remains uncertain, but no available evidence request could resolve this and no better-supported structural revision is indicated.

C0002 has a coherent CNV-defined identity (low FGA, absence of CDKN2A/JAK2/9p losses) with no technical confounding and low label echo. Cross-modal support is weak to moderate and boundaries are not sharp, leaving structural defensibility uncertain, but no available request could resolve this and no supported split or merge is indicated.

C0003 shows strong, coherent RNA and CNV identity evidence (oxidative phosphorylation up, hypoxia/glycolysis down, retained 3p loci, chr1q loss) with no technical confounding and low label echo. Small size and high degenerate resample fraction leave structural defensibility uncertain, but no available request could resolve this and no supported structural revision is indicated.

C0004 has no significant RNA or CNV biological signal, and its apparent structure is CT-driven with strong technical associations to tissue source site and CT manufacturer/reconstruction kernel, making a technical explanation concerning. No credible structural revision resolves this and no available evidence request is expected to reverse it.

C0005 lacks any significant RNA or CNV biological signal, and its cross-modal structure is weak with low ARI and high PAC. Absence of confounding does not provide affirmative support, and no available evidence request is expected to establish a defensible identity.

C0006 has only a weak, non-significant biological signal (chr2p/2q gain without significant enrichment) and weak cross-modal consistency with low membership support. No available evidence request is expected to establish a defensible identity.

C0007 has a coherent inflammatory/immune RNA signature (IL6/JAK/STAT3, interferon, complement up-regulation) with modest RNA and WSI cross-modal support. The tissue source site association does not plausibly explain the RNA immune signal, and label echo is low. Structural defensibility remains uncertain, but no available request could resolve this and no supported structural revision is indicated.

C0008 has no significant RNA or CNV biological signal, non-estimable internal structure due to a singleton child, and very small size. No available evidence request is expected to establish a defensible identity.
